title: Negative bias with nonnegative mean
statement: There exist a function $f$ from the one-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs, a real number $a_0<0$, and a real coefficient $a_1$ such that $f(x)$ is the sign determined by the affine form $a_0+a_1x$ for every input $x$, while the mean of the real-valued function associated to $f$ is nonnegative.
